$comment: Harness MCP connections (Claude Code project scope). Docs per server: agent/mcp/. Env vars expand from your shell / .env. Enable ONLY what an agent needs — every connected server's tool schemas cost context on every turn.

github.$comment: Official GitHub remote MCP (PRs, issues, branches). OAuth on first use. Docs: agent/mcp/github.md

figma.$comment: Figma Dev Mode MCP served by the Figma desktop app (Preferences > Enable Dev Mode MCP Server). Remote alternative: https://mcp.figma.com/mcp. Feeds design/tools/extract.mjs. Docs: agent/mcp/figma.md

playwright.$comment: Browser automation for the reviewer (E2E checks). The design gate does NOT use this — design/tools/ drives Playwright directly so results are deterministic and diffable.

database.$comment: Universal DB MCP via DBHub. READ-ONLY by default — never point agents at prod read-write. Docs: agent/mcp/database.md

context7.$comment: Up-to-date library docs — reduces hallucinated APIs. Optional.

atlassian.$comment: Official Atlassian remote MCP — Jira + Confluence (OAuth). Optional; enable only if you actually track work there. Docs: agent/mcp/jira.md

slack.$comment: Community Slack MCP. Optional — gate notices only. Verify package & scopes before use. Docs: agent/mcp/slack.md

firebase.$comment: Official Firebase CLI MCP server (firebase-tools >=15). Auto-detects tools from firebase.json + enabled GCP APIs for the active project. Uses your existing `firebase login` session — no separate token. Feeds E01 (Identity & Access) and E11 (Firebase Metadata Sync). Docs: https://firebase.google.com/docs/cli/mcp-server. NOTE: pinned to the absolute path because this machine's PATH resolves an older firebase-tools@13.28.0 (no mcp command) ahead of the upgraded 15.28.1 install.

stitch.$comment: Google Stitch — AI UI design generation, feeds docs/UI/ source for design-fidelity (Q-DESIGN-001). Per Google's own docs (stitch.withgoogle.com/docs/mcp/setup), the MCP endpoint needs an OAuth access token via gcloud, NOT the Stitch Settings-page API key — that key only works against Stitch's REST API. Docs: agent/mcp/stitch.md
